description: This file declares the interface for a keyword set library used in pattern matching and text search operations, primarily related to the GNU grep codebase. It includes data structures, function prototypes for creating, extending, preparing, executing, and freeing keyword sets.

methods.name: kwsalloc
methods.description: Allocates and initializes a new keyword set with an optional character translation table.

methods.name: kwsincr
methods.description: Adds a pattern or keyword to the existing keyword set, returning an error message if unsuccessful.

methods.name: kwsprep
methods.description: Finalizes the keyword set, preparing it for searches.

methods.name: kwsexec
methods.description: Searches within a buffer for any of the keywords in the set, returning the match details.

methods.name: kwsfree
methods.description: Deallocates the keyword set and associated resources.

ctags.name: index
ctags.pattern: /^  int index;			\/* Index number of matching keyword. *\/$/

ctags.name: offset
ctags.pattern: /^  size_t offset[1];		\/* Offset of each submatch. *\/$/

ctags.name: size
ctags.pattern: /^  size_t size[1];		\/* Length of each submatch. *\/$/
